title: Approval
description: A named sign-off. approvalClass=human requires principalKind=human AND trust=authenticated_human — an agent may not stand in for a person, and a self-reported declaration is not a person. Read the trust definition before relying on this: the check is a labelling discipline, not authentication.

trust.description: See shared-definitions#/definitions/evidenceTrust. A declaration made with scripts/declare-intent.sh is self_reported and cannot back an approvalClass=human record.
